correctness.rationale: Exact integral triangular coordinates on a=1, t=b, U=c+b², W=d+bc and V=e+U²-4b²U+5b⁴ give F=W²+UV-2t^6; reversing coordinates treats e=1. Differentiation produces (U,V,W,t^5) for p!=2,3 and (U,V,W,t^6) as intrinsic singular ideal in p=3; in p=3 gradients alone give a reduced line/C_- plus isolated reduced Q off cubic, and F restricts to -2s^6t^6 on C_- (thus 6Pa+6Pe). In p=2, global gradients are three quadrics, complete intersection (2,2,2) with local k[t,W]/W², Hilbert 8m-4, genus5. No geometric singular point with a=e=0; hypersurface is irreducible/normal by gcd and R1+S2. Independent SymPy expansion verified exact integral identity, quartic restriction and both Groebner ideal inclusions in p=2,3,5,7; finite checks cannot certify all characteristics or scheme support, which follow from proofs.
